institution.name: DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program (Berliner Künstlerprogramm des DAAD)

qualifications: Open applications only in literature, music & sound, and film; visual arts candidates are nominated by a jury
Artists residing primarily in Germany are generally excluded
German nationals living abroad must show at least six years of primary residence in the country they apply from
description_short: The DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program offers residency fellowships for 2028: 12 months in literature and in music & sound, 6 months in film. Applications close 15 December 2026, 23:59 CET. For 2028 the single collective fellowship is in music & sound.

deadline.evidence_quote: The deadline for submissions in the disciplines of literature and music & sound (12 months residency) and film (6 months residency) will be on December 15, 2026 (23:59 CET).
